name: reproduction
description: Scientific paper replication workflows: assess candidate papers for reproducibility (`assess-reproducibility`), carry out a complete independently verified replication (`reproduce`), and compare reproduced figures, tables, and values with the originals (`figure-comparison`). Bundles the ASTRA reference and validation hooks, so this plugin is self-contained for reproduction work.
